_why: Findings that come from the source texts themselves, counted so a new one fails the check. brenton and webc: verse numbers that the Greek or critical base text omits (for example Acts 8:37, Luke 17:36, and Septuagint chapters that run shorter than the Hebrew). cpdv: five verses that the source file leaves blank. dra and vulgate have none.

knownEmptyChapters.brenton/PRO 30: The Septuagint rearranges Proverbs 24 and 30-31; Brenton prints this chapter's text under other numbers. The reader shows the chapter as empty.
